column1: # REQ-026 readout: momentum benefit = (kernel val_loss) - (mu0 val_loss) at the SAME batch size.
# Negative = the kernel LOWERS loss vs no-momentum (momentum helps). This within-batch-size comparison
# is the primary readout (it shares any LR-schedule confound, per the request). n=1 per cell -> discovery, not significance.
# Jeffrey's expectation: benefit PERSISTS at large batch (geometry). Alternative: benefit SHRINKS toward 0 (denoising).
# READOUT: the bimaxwell (two-rate record) kernel gives a clear, monotone benefit over no-momentum at BOTH batch sizes,
#   but that benefit is ~1.8-2.3x SMALLER at 4x than 1x and the ratio widens over training -> DENOISING-leaning
#   (benefit shrinks with batch), though it does NOT vanish (4x bimax still helps by ~0.0044 @2750).
#   Single-EMA momentum (mu=0.95 plain muon) shows NO durable benefit over mu=0 at either batch (all |Δ| <= ~0.0016,
#   decaying to noise by 2750) -> the benefit here is specific to the two-rate bimaxwell structure, not momentum per se.
